name: Whisper Leech
summary: A fat, grey slug the size of a cat that clings to a skull and murmurs borrowed thoughts into its host.
description: Cultists keep whisper leeches as pets, confessors, and spies, and wear them under hoods where they feed on dreams. A host who loses its leech is said to wake screaming for a week.

traits.name: Thought Anchor
traits.text: A creature that starts its turn with the leech attached to it takes {dmg:1d6:psychic}, and the leech regains hit points equal to the damage dealt.

actions.name: Cling
actions.onHit: The leech attaches to the target. While attached, the leech can't make this attack again, and it moves with the target. The leech can detach itself at any time, and a creature within 5 feet of it can pull it off as an action.
